notes: OpenCode 2.x through the service API (#2109 P5b-2). A turn whose every model request fails (mock-openai-error, HTTP 503). After 2.x's own retries the turn ends failed: the session goes to error and stays there — it does not stick in working, and never waits.

text: The API session is admitted when its first activity lands (P3, #2107): a ses_… transcript_new. Its first state is not pinned — an API session is first seen working (P4; P5a's smoke cells)
The session binds to the one running 2.x service (pid.go servicePIDFor) — there is no client process
The prompt drives the session to working, where it stays through 2.x's retries
The plugin's session.execution.failed ends the turn (recorded as the canonical Stop hook)
The failed turn ends in error and the session stays there — never ready, waiting or working again (unbounded: no later turn)
